notes.text: The app now speaks Bulgarian: pick "Български" in Profile › Language, or let it follow your device.
The app now speaks Catalan: pick "Català" in Profile › Language, or let it follow your device.
The app now speaks Danish: pick "Dansk" in Profile › Language, or let it follow your device.
Groups can now split in the Danish krone (DKK), and a group made in Denmark, Greenland or the Faroe Islands starts in it.
The app now speaks Finnish: pick "Suomi" in Profile › Language, or let it follow your device.
The app now speaks Marathi: pick "मराठी" in Profile › Language, or let it follow your device.
The app now speaks Norwegian: pick "Norsk bokmål" in Profile › Language, or let it follow your device.
Groups can now split in the Norwegian krone (NOK), and a group made in Norway starts in it.
The app now speaks Persian: pick "فارسی" in Profile › Language, or let it follow your device.
Groups can now split in the Iranian rial (IRR), and a group made in Iran starts in it.
The app now speaks Slovak: pick "Slovenčina" in Profile › Language, or let it follow your device.
The app now speaks Swahili: pick "Kiswahili" in Profile › Language, or let it follow your device. New groups in Kenya and Tanzania start in the Kenyan or Tanzanian shilling.
The app now speaks Tamil: pick "தமிழ்" in Profile › Language, or let it follow your device.
The app now speaks Telugu: pick "తెలుగు" in Profile › Language, or let it follow your device.
On iPhone, iPad and Mac, dates in Thai and Persian now show the Gregorian year, as on Android and the web, whatever calendar the device uses.
